# Mykyta Knysh

> Lead Test Automation Engineer, AI-first, ISTQB Certified Test Manager. 14 years building and scaling QA and test automation across enterprise fintech, SaaS and microservice systems. Available for contract work: nknysh@gmail.com.

Mykyta plans testing around product risk, builds test automation that teams can trust in CI/CD, and leads QA processes across teams. He is also a Board Member and Lead Expert with USQB, overseeing ISTQB course accreditation standards.

Core skills: Playwright, Cypress, Nightwatch.js, Selenium; UI and API testing (REST, GraphQL, gRPC); mobile testing (iOS, Android); CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI); AWS; SQL, DynamoDB, MongoDB; AI-assisted testing with Claude Code and GitHub Copilot.

## Case studies

- [Portfolio overview](https://nknysh.github.io/cv/portfolio/): All case studies and track record
- [Introducing the QA Function](https://nknysh.github.io/cv/portfolio/first-qa-function.html): Introduced the first QA function and moved release verification to CI/CD with around 2,000 automated tests
- [Test Strategy from Scratch](https://nknysh.github.io/cv/portfolio/test-strategy-from-scratch.html): Built the test strategy, test automation framework and CI pipeline from scratch for a new product and team
- [Playwright Suite Stability](https://nknysh.github.io/cv/portfolio/playwright-suite-stability.html): Eliminated test flakiness and cut UI test execution time by 50% in a Playwright suite of 1,100 tests
- [Unifying QA Across Teams](https://nknysh.github.io/cv/portfolio/unified-qa-practices.html): Unified QA practices across four Scrum teams and cut escaped defects by 70-85%
- [Modernizing Test Automation](https://nknysh.github.io/cv/portfolio/automation-50-to-2200.html): Grew test automation from 50 to 2,200 tests on an up-to-date framework owned by the test team
- [UI Library Visual Testing](https://nknysh.github.io/cv/portfolio/ui-library-testing.html): Covered a new reusable library of interactive UI elements with 900+ visual tests and functional UI tests
